resolution_notes: base_url: replace; OwnTracks is self-hosted and documents http[s]://recorder_host[:port]/pub, so no universal live base exists (https://owntracks.org/booklet/tech/http/). docs_url: replace with current JSON docs (https://owntracks.org/booklet/tech/json/). cors: yes; Recorder JSON responses send Access-Control-Allow-Origin: * (https://raw.githubusercontent.com/owntracks/recorder/master/http.c). example: replace; official /pub testing uses u and d, and HTTP 200 typically returns [] (https://owntracks.org/booklet/tech/http/).
